agent_evaluations.additional_comments: This evaluation task fundamentally mismatches the radiology interpretation expert role. The provided content is an administrative JSON file containing OSCE scenario metadata (52 case outlines with placeholder image references), not actual radiological imaging requiring systematic interpretation. A radiology interpretation expert requires actual CXR, CT, ultrasound, or ECG images to apply systematic frameworks (ABCDE, 7-step ECG, ABC CT). Without viewable imaging content, no clinical interpretation, Australian terminology application, or finding identification is possible. This content should be evaluated by an OSCE curriculum design expert or medical education specialist, not a radiologist. To utilize radiology interpretation expertise, provide actual DICOM files, image screenshots, or detailed radiology reports requiring validation.

suggestions: ENDO-OSCE-0003 (DKA): Develop insulin sliding scale protocol (ActRapid 6-10 units/hour IV, adjust for BSL), potassium replacement (40 mmol/L if K+ 3.5-5.5), fluid resuscitation (0.9% NaCl 1L/hour initially)
ENDO-OSCE-0001 (Hyperthyroidism): Add carbimazole dosing (20-40mg daily, titrate to TFTs), propranolol for symptomatic control (40mg TDS), PBS authority requirements
ENDO-OSCE-0002 (Hypothyroidism): Specify levothyroxine starting dose (50-100 microgram daily, 25 microgram if elderly/cardiac disease), titration protocol (check TSH 6-8 weeks), PBS unrestricted

GENE-OSCE-0031 (Drug Toxicity): Develop specific antidote protocols - paracetamol (N-acetylcysteine 150mg/kg loading), opioid (naloxone 400 microgram IV), benzodiazepine (flumazenil 200 microgram IV), digoxin (DigiFab)
CARD-OSCE-0012 (Bradycardia): Add atropine dosing (600 microgram IV, repeat to max 3mg), isoprenaline infusion (1-10 microgram/min), temporary pacing indications

GAST-OSCE-0039-0044 (Electrolyte disorders): Develop correction protocols - hyponatremia (0.9% NaCl or 3% saline, max 10 mmol/L/24h), hyperkalemia (calcium gluconate 10% 10mL IV, insulin-dextrose 10 units + 50mL 50% dextrose)
Add renal dosing adjustments for all scenarios involving CKD patients (metformin contraindicated if eGFR <30, gentamicin dose reduction, DOAC dose adjustment)
Include STOPP/START criteria for elderly patient scenarios (avoid anticholinergics, benzodiazepines; ensure appropriate statin, ACE inhibitor if indicated)
Add therapeutic drug monitoring protocols for narrow therapeutic index drugs (digoxin target 0.8-2.0 nmol/L, lithium 0.6-1.2 mmol/L, gentamicin trough <1 mg/L)
Specify drug-drug interaction management for polypharmacy scenarios (warfarin + clarithromycin → check INR 3-5 days, ACE inhibitor + spironolactone → monitor K+ and creatinine)

agent_evaluations.reviewer_notes: This file contains OSCE skeleton templates without medication content to evaluate. All 52 OSCEs lack specific drug names, doses, routes, frequencies, PBS codes, or medication management tasks. Cannot assess Australian drug nomenclature compliance, PBS compliance, dosing accuracy, or drug interactions due to absence of pharmacotherapy content. This is a structural/planning document, not a clinically complete OSCE script ready for deployment. Recommend: (1) Develop full clinical scenarios with patient vignettes, vital signs, investigation results; (2) Add specific medication management tasks with Australian drug names; (3) Include PBS codes and authority requirements; (4) Populate reference content fields with eTG/AMH/PBS recommendations; (5) Add renal/hepatic dosing adjustments; (6) Include drug interaction checks; (7) Develop polypharmacy management for elderly scenarios. Estimated development effort: 40-80 hours for 52 complete medication-focused OSCEs meeting Australian standards.
